Wide cinematic landscape built entirely from cubic voxel blocks in a blocky sandbox video game style: rolling square grass-topped hills, blocky trees with cube leaves, a calm lake of square water blocks, at dusk with a smooth deep purple to orange sky and the first stars. In the right third of the picture a large smooth matte black sphere floats in the air above the hills. On the front of the sphere is one single photorealistic human eye: glossy wet white sclera with thin red veins, a detailed hazel-green iris, black pupil, a small wet highlight. A thin soft violet rim light outlines the edge of the sphere. The left half of the sky is open, calm and smooth gradient. Moody, mysterious, gentle, kid-friendly
